verdict.rationale: The docs say you can carve out independent tasks and run them simultaneously, and the API and MCP server expose programmatic session management. Together these would let a user fan work out across many items. Devin also targets codebase-wide migrations and refactors, but the pack documents no dedicated bulk or batch operation. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk API or UI for acting on many items at once, documentation of parallel fan-out limits or workflows, and hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.
